svg.title: Stolarski–Su: a neck collapsing at three times
svg.desc: Asymptotic illustration using exact Lawlor profiles. Three projected two-dimensional slices and their planar profiles at the same spatial scale; not numerical flow slices.
svg.text: A shrinking neck, two different blow-up limits
Stolarski–Su · n = 3, K = 2 · full flow in C³ = R⁶
Asymptotic model only · exact Lawlor geometry with a prescribed shrinking scale
Blue / ochre: two sides of the neck. Purple: its waist. Gray rays: limiting planes.
Half of a 2D slice is projected to expose the neck. Crossings are projection artifacts.
τ = (t − t₀)/(T − t₀), a/a₀ = (1 − τ)ᴷ⁄². All panels share one camera and scale.
The actual flow includes a PDE correction. A shrinking family of minimal necks is not itself MCF.
